sentences.text:
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Chutia P.S. Case No. 144 of 2024,
registered under sections 270, 290, 420, 467, 468, 471/34 of I.P.C. and sections 3/4/5/7 of the Immoral Trafficking Act, 1956, pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that false allegations are made against the petitioners.

He further submits that raid was conducted in Hotel Royal Residency, Gurudwara Gali, Station Road, Ranchi where some men and women were found involved in immoral trafficking and they were apprehended with incriminating articles.
The name of the petitoner has been taken by the manager of the hotel.

He next submits that in identical situation two of the co-accused persons have been granted anticipatory bail in A.B.A. No. 5809 of 2024 and A.B.A. No. 6548 of 2024 by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court.
On these grounds, he submits that the petitioner may kindly be provided privilege of anticipatory bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer and submits that allegations of immoral trafficking are there.

5. Considering that in identical situations two of the co-accused ( 2026:JHHC:32 ) persons have been granted anticipatory bail in the aforesaid A.B.As and there are allegations of immoral Roshan Kumar Singh @ Shail @ Raja Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... ... ... on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192828549/
1 trafficking and name of the petitioner was taken by the manager of the hotel, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

entities.text: Roshan Kumar Singh @ Shail @ Raja Singh
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text:
Accordingly, the above named, petitioner is directed to surrender before the learned court within three weeks from today and in the event of his surrender / arrest, the petitioner shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (twenty five thousand)
with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi,
in connection with Chutia P.S. Case No. 144 of 2024, subject to conditions as laid down under Section 482 (2) of B.N.S.S, 2023.
